R_A_SCIENTIFIC_OBJECT: Can one pre-specified, low-degrees-of-freedom, price-derived discrete state representation at a frozen time scale exhibit chronological held-out transition/persistence structure, on historically exposed research data, that cannot be explained by a frozen lower-order null model?
R_A_constraints: no trying multiple feature families and retaining the prettiest
no selecting horizon/window after label inspection
a positive state model is NOT itself an edge claim

SURROGATE_NULL_REQUIREMENT.insufficient_null_warning: A null preserving only unconditional marginal distribution + linear autocorrelation/spectrum is NOT automatically acceptable if the candidate representation uses volatility clustering, vol-of-vol, realized-volatility term structure, path roughness, or nonlinear temporal dependence. Such a null can mechanically destroy the very second-order dependence under test and manufacture a guaranteed positive contrast.
SURROGATE_NULL_REQUIREMENT.requirement: The null must preserve every lower-order structure that the claim does not intend to label as regime structure, and may destroy only the structure under test.
SURROGATE_NULL_REQUIREMENT.reusability_scope: A defensible lower-order null construction would be reusable methodological infrastructure for future PRICE-PATH / STATE-DETECTION studies that ask whether apparent state persistence exceeds lower-order temporal dependence. R-C, R-D and R-E may require materially different null/comparator structures.
SURROGATE_NULL_REQUIREMENT.selection_rule: the surrogate/null family must be chosen OUTCOME-BLIND, never after seeing label persistence
